messages:
maya-fin: Quick ask - before we run the pricing experiment next week we need a checklist for invoice previews + GL tagging. Who can own each piece?

sam-billing: I can own cohort export and preview flow. Will add invoice_meta.pilot=pm-exp-2026 and preview_flag=true.

nina-legal: I'll review notices. Exclude annual/committed-price contracts. Add contract_status column to export.

jordan-revops: Revops needs pilot revenue mapped to pm_experiment_rev GL so we can track recognition separately. Sam can you add revenue_account mapping?

anya-cs: CS needs preview wording + a canned response. Also a quick playbook for disputes. Avoid phrase "price increase" in any customer-facing text.

sam-billing: Export columns I'll include: customer_id, contract_status, last_invoice_dispute_90d, monthly_spend_est, am_owner, billing_currency, pilot_tag. I'll hold preview in sandbox mode for 48h first.

maya-fin: Decision rules: remove accounts with disputes>2 in 90d or annual locked. Abort if dispute_rate_48h > 1.5%.

billing-bot: preview-deploy created: pilot=pm-exp-2026, users=120, mode=preview_sandbox, created_by=maya-fin

nina-legal: Send draft email and I'll check required disclosure line.

sam-billing: Will DM the export link shortly and tag legal + CS.

maya-fin: Thanks all. Plan: export today -> legal OK tomorrow -> 48h preview -> finance reconciliation -> decision on billed pilot.
